holds.name: node
holds.reason: engines.node in the private root manifest is the development floor the CI matrix verifies (Node 24 and 26 in .github/workflows/ci.yml), not a toolchain pin: an exact Node nightly there would name a Node no CI leg runs, and under engine-strict makes `pnpm install` fail with ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE on every CI leg and contributor machine
holds.evidence: 2026-10-31: root package.json {"engines":{"node":"28.0.0-nightly202610304e48b9b06b"}} + `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=true` on Node 26.13.0 exits 1: ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE, wanted {"node":"28.0.0-nightly202610304e48b9b06b"} (current {"node":"26.13.0"}); without engine-strict the same install exits 0, so the floor is enforced by the CI matrix, not by pnpm

holds.name: node
holds.reason: engines.node in the published package is the consumer support floor, not a toolchain pin: an exact Node nightly there makes `pnpm install` of modern-xlsx fail with ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE for every consumer on another Node build under engine-strict, and misstates the supported range for every other consumer
holds.evidence: 2026-10-31 consumer repro: a dependency libx with {"engines":{"node":"28.0.0-nightly202610304e48b9b06b"}} installed by a consumer project on Node 26.13.0: `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=true` exits 1 (Unsupported engine for libx@file:../lib: wanted {"node":"28.0.0-nightly202610304e48b9b06b"} current {"node":"26.13.0"}); the default install exits 0
